verdict.rationale: Check documents that it handles money movement for payroll and collects employee bank account information. It also offers payment operations (list/retry/refund/cancel) and sandbox bank-account failure simulation, which together imply direct-deposit payroll in place of checks. No evidence states deposit timing, so the 'fast (next-day or 2-day)' core of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented next-day or 2-day direct deposit timing, explicit direct-deposit funding/settlement docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.
